comments: cef1b57b: This section of the code is responsible for generating the totals page by division, which includes printing out the division names and their corresponding total delinquencies.
272e8f5e: Print the division name and the total number of delinquencies for that division.
76d143f6: End of the procedure to print totals by division.
1bab6aff: Initializes the totals page by setting the header with division names and total delinquencies.
465cd7cd: Filler lines to ensure consistent formatting on the totals page.
8a3b9e11: Retrieve and display the total delinquencies for the current division from the data.
53d25a43: Check if the output device is a terminal (screen); if not, skip the prompt for continuation.
cc32eea3: Prompt the user to continue with <RET> or quit with ^ if the output is being displayed on a terminal.
d9db2bd8: Reset page number to 0 if the division changes.
30874f87: Print the header for the records listing page, including the report type, sort order, date, and page number.
5bdde1f2: If the list is sorted by event date, format the columns accordingly.
68815e51: If the list is not sorted by event date, format the columns differently to accommodate other sort orders.
4ce22aa6: Print column headers for the detailed records list.
133eeb99: If listing is not sorted by physician, include the physician column and optionally the status and total days columns.
8c23a080: If listing is sorted by physician, adjust column headings to align properly with data.
fcbad9ca: End of the procedure to print the detailed records list.
87a9399b: Clean up by killing local variables used in the report generation process.
a4464200: Clean up additional variables and system resources used by the report.
3018ce56: Further cleanup of global variables and closing of resources.
560a45d4: Close any open devices or files before exiting the procedure.
bb463018: Conditionally print the count of records for a physician if there are no more records to list.
21a51925: Conditionally print a subtotal for a service within a division when there are no more patient records to list.
c45cbcd8: Print service subtotals and prompt for continuation if output is being displayed on a terminal.
365ada6b: End of the procedure to print subtotals and handle terminal output.
47b5f6c5: Print the 3-letter abbreviation for the record type, if available.
428facb2: If detailing undictated records, display the status abbreviation next to the record type.
25e247ab: Display the total number of days delayed for the record.
3426d723: End of the procedure to print individual record details.
